methods.label: Apply the minus-parenthesis rule
methods.explanation: The parentheses are preceded by a minus sign, so every term inside changes sign when the parentheses are removed: \(-2x+3y-1\).
methods.levelReason: Directly applies the Grade 7 rule for removing parentheses preceded by a minus sign.
